subject: Auditing and Ethics
question_text:
7.
Suggest the audit team members of LMN & Co. to match the apt combination
from the following information as per SA 300.

Description

Elements of Planning
(a) Evaluating compliance with ethical
requirement, including independence
(i)
Audit Programme
(b) Detailed plan of applying audit
procedures
(ii)
Preliminary
engagement activity
(c)
Determination of materiality
(iii) Audit Strategy
(d) Consideration
of
number
and
location of branches for audit
(iv) Audit Plan
(A)  (a)-(iv), (b)-(iii), (c)-(ii), (d)-(i)
(B)  (a)-(ii), (b)-(i), (c)-(iv), (d)-(iii)
(C)  (a)-(iii), (b)-(iv), (c)-(ii), (d)-(i)
(D)  (a)-(ii), (b)-(iv), (c)-(i), (d)-(iii)
(2 Marks)
